verdict.rationale: Railway offers a CLI and an MCP server for programmatic workflows (railway-docs-15, railway-docs-16), suggesting some parity with UI actions, but there is no documented public API/OpenAPI spec confirming full feature parity — a probe for openapi.json returned 404 on all candidate paths (railway-probe-2). Missing for 10: a documented public REST/GraphQL API reference, explicit claims of UI-API parity, and independent confirmation that all UI actions are exposed programmatically.
